parameters.question: Compare STAR Chimeric.out.junction records for candidate fusion junctions. Junction records must match the reference in donor and acceptor chromosome, position, and strand (columns 1-6); read-level annotation columns (junction type, repeat lengths, read names, alignment starts/CIGARs) may differ. Row order may differ.

Compare candidate fusion junction tables derived from STAR chimeric junction output. Fusion records must match the reference in chr1, base1, strand1, chr2, base2, strand2, and junction_type; row and column order may differ.
